trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to hunt down. Work the roadmap in order - story, stranger strands, activity sweeps, then collectibles - and this one closes the account last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. It is the first thing the game asks you to play, so it cannot be missed: see the prologue through to its end and the trophy unlocks as the mission wraps up.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 1. The story is linear, so there are no branches to get wrong - keep following the main markers and the trophy lands when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 2. As with the first chapter, progress is a straight line through the main jobs; the trophy is awarded at the moment Chapter 2 closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 3. Nothing optional gates it: play the chapter's main missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter break.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 4. Keep pushing the main story markers; the trophy is awarded when the fourth chapter's last job is done.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign's final mission. Because it ends a linear story it cannot be missed, and the gold is yours as the finale concludes. Any activity or collectible work left over can still be finished afterwards in free roam, so there is no need to delay the ending for it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the main-story mission Breakfast Run. It arrives in sequence as you play the campaign, and no choice or side condition gates it - completing the job is the whole requirement.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the main-story mission The Cartel Heist. The heist plays out inside the campaign, so completing its finale earns the trophy whatever approach you chose for the job.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the main-story mission Child's Play. It is one of the campaign's set jobs, unlocked in order; play it to the end and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the main-story mission Headliners. A straight campaign job with no optional conditions - complete it as the story presents it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the main-story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Play the job through to its conclusion as part of the campaign sequence.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the main-story mission Operation Savage Glory. It belongs to the main campaign line, so completing the operation as briefed earns the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion on the stats screen. Behind that figure sits the whole game - story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and discoveries all feed it - so use the completion menu as your ledger and mop up category by category with this tracker's filters until nothing is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt events across Leonida: marked jumps and other stunt spots each count once toward the total. Stunts stay available in free roam after the story, so sweep them region by region and let the counter climb rather than grinding one spot.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once - races, fishing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, drone racing, shooting-range play and the rest. A single attempt at each is enough; this trophy checks breadth, not mastery.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range runs weapon challenges scored on accuracy and time; replay a challenge until its medal turns gold, and finish one range completely before moving to the next so none are left half-done.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Only a win counts, so take a practice lap to learn each course, then race it clean; every location can be revisited freely in free roam.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Replays of an event you have already won do not add to the count, so move on to a fresh race after each victory and work through the map's race icons in a planned route.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of Leonida's water activities; when Cal's challenge is on offer, take him on and land the better haul to win the contest.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Cabinets sit inside arcades and bars around Vice City - pick the shortest game on offer and play it through to its end screen instead of quitting mid-run.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Strands advance one job at a time: after each job his marker returns to the map later, so keep checking back until his storyline reaches its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Work through Kenton's jobs whenever his marker appears on the map; the trophy arrives with the closing job of his chain.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Billy's jobs appear in stages across the map - finish each one and return when the next surfaces until the strand ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of jobs for one character, and finishing a chain is what counts: the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of the eight you need.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Follow Randy's marker through each job in his chain; the trophy unlocks when his last job is done.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Tyrone's jobs unlock one after another on the map - keep returning until his storyline closes with its final job.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots sit at scenic overlooks and quiet corners of the state, and each needs only a single session, so clear them region by region on the same trips as your other collectibles.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take the job from Bret, track the named animal in its home territory and bring the hunt to a clean finish - ordinary animals do not count, only the unique one tied to his request.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden pickups spread over the whole state and each belongs to a set, so concentrate on finishing three sets completely instead of scattering single pickups across every set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Marked WAiNK spots turn up in shops, venues and street corners across Leonida, and each unique location counts once - sweep them as you pass through each neighbourhood rather than hunting them one by one.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges track across driving, combat and activities as you play, so open the list, pin the ones that are nearly finished, and close those out deliberately instead of waiting for them to happen.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the heat and escape. Cause trouble together until the fourth star lights, break line of sight and stay out of view until the stars drain - both partners must still be together when the escape completes.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without your wanted level ever dropping. The chain breaks if the stars vanish between shops, so pick three stores close together before you start and move straight from till to till.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts the first time you get into it, so swap cars constantly, wander dealerships and car parks, and try every unfamiliar model you pass on the street.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Set the moment up first - a gang spot or a busy mission firefight - then trigger Combat Focus with targets already in front of you and drop five before the effect expires.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA, the airport. The natural window is the story business that puts you on the airfield: when it does, leave by air or road away from the scripted exit instead of following the marker out. This guide flags it missable - play that visit straight and a locked-down airport may not offer the chance again, so take the detour while the story has you there.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos - the game's tanks - being hot to sit in. The trophy is about facing one down: Rhinos deploy during the heaviest military responses and in mission set-pieces, so steal or survive an encounter with one on your terms and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, move quietly, stay out of staff sightlines and finish the grab before anything trips - if you are spotted the attempt is void, so leave, let the area cool down and try another store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape afterwards. Vault jobs are the heavy end of free-roam crime: crack the vault, take the money and lose the responding heat. Only robberies you escape from count toward the five.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The trucks run delivery routes in free roam - stop one, force the rear doors, take the cash and break away before the response pins you down.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 named areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so late in a completion run compare the area list with your map and sweep whatever is still blank - islands, swamp pockets and back roads are the usual stragglers.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own rackets, and the trophy wants one hit per gang rather than nine against the same colours - keep a note of which gangs you have already covered.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront strip in Vice City, order a cocktail at one of the bars facing the water and take the moment in - a small scene-setting stop rather than a challenge.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom through the glass, in classic style. The chance comes with the story's showroom business: while you are inside with a car, drive it out through the storefront instead of using the door. This guide flags it missable - play that visit politely and the set-piece may never repeat, so take the wheel when the moment comes.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, follow-through included. Bowling is one of Leonida's leisure activities - start a match at the alley and finish it rather than walking away mid-game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description only hints at a partnership with mass appeal, and that is the shape of it: this tracks the duo, not either lead alone. Work the pair's joint jobs and shared appearances until their partnership milestone registers and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a counter of 500 behind this one: choices you make - in dialogue, in missions and in free-roam encounters - all feed it. Individual choices are one-time events, which is why this guide flags it: if a particular outcome matters to you, decide before the moment passes. The count itself keeps growing all game long, so steady play fills it.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail at something the game lets you retry, then succeed on the repeat attempt. A botched race, challenge or job taken again straight away and completed is the natural way this one triggers.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange encounters - the odd sights and unexplained events tucked away off the beaten path. Explore remote spots, especially at night, and investigate anything that looks out of place; the trophy marks the first time you see something that should not be there.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a person down with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect with someone so they go over like a bowling pin. Low speed and a busy pavement make the timing forgiving.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Big scores pay out in marked money that cannot be spent raw, so route it through your laundering contacts instead; the cleaned total accumulates across the whole game toward the quarter million.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Clothing, weapons, vehicles and services all count toward the same lifetime figure, so it arrives on its own if you keep both leads kitted out as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are sold through property signs and listings around Leonida and sit at the expensive end of the property ladder, so leave the buying until the big story payouts have landed.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it through the app so it is stored under your name; ten registrations fill the quota.
